Definition: harvest (as the crop), whether the product (grain or fruit) or the (dry) season
BiblicalUsage: Summer fruit is the sign of the end: Amos sees a basket of summer fruit, and the LORD says, the end is come upon my people of Israel; Jeremiah cries, the harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved; and Ziba met David with an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the summer fruit as the season that does not wait, and the harvest past as the warning that the time to turn is now.
